scope_notes: Only public commands and SDK outputs were inspected in an empty owned document on private Xvfb.
Native commands run at idle, outside RunPythonScript Undo; complete EndCommand, post-macro, Undo and Redo snapshots are retained.
Axis defaults are seeded through public ScaleNU command input on a disposable point before source construction.

Complete numeric maps, signed/zero factors, CPlane/world axes, selected grips and parent precedence, mixed peer copy order, repeated copies, command-first selection and collapsed mesh records match in 20 recipes.
Four second-reference distance-constrained recipes match, including a negative Z target and an off-axis target. A bare second-reference number awaits a point instead of completing the command.

Six unconstrained coordinate-reference macros produce native scales that differ from projected-axis ratios. Their raw histories, cameras and geometry remain retained. A separate capture establishes a cursor-input dependency for twelve controlled macros; the original six cursor locations were not captured and their compatibility gaps remain.

Application tests replay each recipe twice. Twenty matching workflows provide 40 comparisons at absolute tolerance 1e-9; six incompatible workflows assert the independent axis map and retain their discrepancies. Command-first and repeated-copy recipes use incremental input in both runs.

Rigid/SubCrv options, all singular analytic and trimmed shapes, cross-viewport picks, calculator expressions, preview appearance, scripted cursor-dependent inputs, performance and full parity remain unproven. Twenty additional real cursor/keyboard point workflows are verified separately.
